architectureChanges.reason: Logical Panel composition and arbitrary Widget projection lack a public view handoff into an unaware renderer.
architectureChanges.before: Panel factory/receive works; generic renderer has no public mountable feature view.
architectureChanges.after: Distinct Panel and Widget view contributions share controlled mount ownership/lifecycle/failure/fencing semantics.

findings.rootCause: The public contract ended at logical data projection; no production-facing renderer contribution bridge.
The extension main table still taught superseded qualification names.
